About this experience
Discover the Mediterranean coastline on a full-day boat tour featuring turquoise water, quiet bays, sea caves and striking natural scenery.
The experience includes scenic swimming stops around Suluada and nearby coastal bays. Depending on the operating route, weather and sea conditions, the captain may adjust the sequence of stops or replace locations with suitable alternatives.
During the cruise, guests can relax on deck, swim in clear water and enjoy lunch on board. Hotel or apartment transfer from the Alanya region is included.
This tour is ideal for couples, families and travelers looking for a long, scenic day at sea away from the city.

items.faq:
Is the round-trip cable-car ticket included?
+
Yes. The round-trip Alanya Cable Car ticket is included in the tour price for confirmed participants.
Which places are included?
+
The route includes stops at Alanya Panorama, the Alanya Castle district, Cleopatra Beach and the Damlataş area.
Can we swim at Cleopatra Beach?
+
Yes. Seasonal swimming is allowed during the beach stop when weather and sea conditions are suitable.
Is Damlataş Cave included?
+
The Damlataş area is included. Entering the cave is optional, and the cave entrance fee is paid separately unless a different arrangement is confirmed.
Does the tour operate every day?
+
The planned operation is daily, but availability depends on season, weather, minimum participation and cable-car operating conditions. Advance confirmation is required.
How long does the tour take?
+
The approximate duration is 5–6 hours. Exact timing depends on pickup location, traffic, sunset time and the confirmed route.
What is the child policy?
+
Children aged 0–5 join free of charge, children aged 6–11 use the child price, and guests aged 12 and above use the adult price.
Are children included in transport and cable-car arrangements?
+
Yes. Children included in the confirmed booking are included in the tour’s transport and cable-car arrangements according to the reservation details.
Is guide service included?
+
Yes. Guide service is included.

Mamure Castle & Anemurium
Medieval Fortress • Ancient Coastal City • Banana Plantations • Mediterranean Swimming
A full-day cultural journey from Alanya combining one of Türkiye’s best-preserved Mediterranean castles, the ancient port city of Anemurium, Anamur’s banana-growing landscape and seasonal seaside swimming.

About this experience
Mamure Castle and Anemurium create one of the most distinctive historical routes on Türkiye’s eastern Mediterranean coast. The excursion combines medieval fortifications, a major ancient port settlement, coastal scenery and the agricultural landscape of Anamur.
Mamure Castle stands approximately six kilometres east of Anamur. It was built over earlier Roman foundations and developed through Byzantine, Seljuk, Karamanid and Ottoman periods. The fortress includes defensive walls, towers, courtyards, cisterns, a historic mosque and a surrounding moat.
Anemurium was an important coastal settlement known from at least the 4th century BC. Its surviving remains include city walls, Roman baths, a theatre, an odeon, a palestra, churches and an extensive necropolis.
The program also includes a stop in Anamur’s banana-growing landscape and seasonal swimming or seaside free time, depending on weather, sea conditions and the confirmed daily route.
The order and duration of visits may change according to seasonal opening hours, site access, traffic, weather and the local operating program.

Roman Theatre • Side Ancient City • Temple of Apollo • Kurşunlu Waterfall
Discover three of the Antalya region’s most memorable attractions in one full-day route: the Roman Theatre of Aspendos, the ancient peninsula of Side and the forest landscape of Kurşunlu Waterfall.

About this experience
This full-day excursion combines archaeology, coastal heritage and nature in one balanced route through the Antalya region.
Aspendos is best known for its exceptionally preserved 2nd-century Roman theatre, associated through its inscriptions with the architect Zenon, son of Theodorus. The wider archaeological site also preserves remains of the agora, basilica, baths, acropolis and an important ancient aqueduct system.
In Side, guests explore the atmosphere of the ancient peninsula, its monumental streets and the Temple of Apollo beside the Mediterranean. Side Theatre is currently closed to visitors because of restoration, so it is presented from accessible exterior areas unless official access conditions change.
Kurşunlu Waterfall offers a contrasting nature stop among pine forest, shaded paths and freshwater scenery.
The order and duration of visits may change according to traffic, weather, site access, restoration work, special events and the confirmed daily program.

About this experience
Discover Cappadocia on a long-distance multi-day journey from Alanya. The region is known for its volcanic valleys, fairy chimneys, rock-cut churches, historic settlements and underground cities.
Cappadocia is one of Türkiye’s most distinctive cultural landscapes, where volcanic rock was gradually shaped by erosion into valleys, stone pillars and the formations known as fairy chimneys. Over the centuries, people carved homes, churches, monasteries and shelters directly into this soft rock, creating a landscape where nature and history remain closely connected.
Göreme National Park and the Rock Sites of Cappadocia are included on the UNESCO World Heritage List and are recognised for their cave sanctuaries, historic settlements and extraordinary geological scenery.
The package includes accommodation in our contracted cave hotel, breakfast, lunch and dinner according to the confirmed program, drinks served at the hotel, and entrance tickets for museums and archaeological sites listed in the confirmed itinerary.
The exact underground city and the order of sightseeing stops may change because our local partner adjusts the daily route according to operating conditions, site access, season and the confirmed program.
Hot-air balloon flights and sunrise balloon viewing are optional. They depend on weather conditions, official flight permission and local availability.

Yes. Entrance tickets to Myra Ancient City and the St. Nicholas Museum are included in the tour price.
Is the Kekova boat trip included?
Yes. The boat trip along the partially submerged ancient ruins of Kekova is included.
Can we swim during the tour?
Yes. A swimming stop is planned when weather, sea conditions and the boat operator’s route allow it.
Can the ancient ruins be seen from the boat?
The boat passes beside partially submerged remains and ruins among the coastal rocks. Visibility depends on light, weather and sea conditions.
Is breakfast included?
No. Guests may request a breakfast box from their hotel in advance or purchase breakfast during the journey stop.
Is lunch included?
Yes. Lunch according to the confirmed daily program is included. Drinks are paid separately.
Which days does the tour operate?
The usual operating days are Monday, Wednesday, Friday and Sunday. Days may change seasonally, so availability must be confirmed before booking.
What time do we return?
Expected hotel return is around 22:00. Exact timing may vary due to traffic, transfer order and operational conditions.
Is the tour suitable for young children?
Yes. The excursion is suitable for families with young children, although it is a long full-day program with an early departure.
What are the child prices?
Children 0–3 are free, children 4–8 pay half price, and children aged 9 and over pay the full price.
What language does the guide speak?
Multilingual guide service is included. The available guide languages are organised according to the selected date and group.
Can the program order change?
Yes. The order and timing of Myra, St. Nicholas, lunch, Kekova and the swimming stop may change according to traffic, weather, sea and operational conditions.

items.faq:
Is the waterpark suitable for small children?
Yes. The complex has separate water areas and 7 slides for children under 7. Children must remain under the constant supervision of an adult.
Which slides are available for children?
The complex has 5 children’s slides for ages 7–14 and 7 slides for children under 7. Access to a specific slide also depends on height, health condition and the attraction’s posted rules.
Can I leave my child in the children’s club?
The children’s club is intended for ages 4–12. This does not mean a child may be left unattended across the entire waterpark. Parents remain responsible for supervision outside the club’s controlled activities.
Are there health restrictions?
Yes. Extreme slides are not recommended for pregnant guests or people with heart, spine or joint conditions, high blood pressure, epilepsy, recent surgery or injuries.
Who decides whether a guest may use a slide?
The final decision is made by the waterpark staff at the specific attraction. Adult accompaniment does not override age, height, health or safety restrictions.
Are all slides open every day?
No. Slides, pools and outdoor zones may close because of weather, season, maintenance, occupancy or operational decisions.
Is Eftalia Island open all year?
No. The aquapark and many outdoor services operate seasonally. Availability is confirmed for the selected date.
What is included in the €60 tour price?
Our adult package includes round-trip transfer, insurance, entrance, access to the operating pools and slides, beach access, buffet lunch and selected soft drinks.
Are sun loungers available?
Sunbathing areas are available, but exact availability and any towel or deposit rules depend on the facility’s current conditions.
Are alcoholic drinks included?
The excursion package includes selected soft drinks. Imported, premium and additional alcoholic beverages are not included unless explicitly confirmed.

Do I need a driving licence?

A B1 driving licence is required to independently drive a qualifying buggy on public roads in Turkey. Requirements for this guided off-road tour may differ depending on the vehicle classification and operator rules, so please confirm them when booking.

Can beginners drive a buggy?

Can children join the tour?

Is the tour suitable during pregnancy?

About this experience
Family Buggy Safari in Alanya
is an exciting off-road adventure for travelers who enjoy active experiences, speed, and unforgettable emotions.
The tour combines thrilling experiences, beautiful natural scenery, and the atmosphere of a real adventure among mountains, forest roads, and picturesque routes along the Mediterranean coast.
The Family Buggy Safari follows forest trails, mountain roads, dusty and muddy tracks, and natural routes far from crowded tourist areas.
After the transfer to the safari base, you will receive a detailed safety briefing, an introduction to the buggy controls, protective equipment, and a test drive of approximately 15 minutes.

Important Family Buggy Safari Safety Rules
Although this is presented as a family experience, the route includes vibration, uneven terrain, mud, dust and sudden movement. Participation, driver approval, passenger seating and route access remain subject to the operator’s final safety assessment.
Briefing & Instructor Rules
Every driver must attend the briefing and complete the test drive. Guests must follow the instructor, keep their place in the group and stop immediately when directed.
Children & Passenger Seating
Children may ride only in the passenger position approved by the operator. They must remain seated, use the fitted restraint and stay under continuous adult supervision throughout the route and stops.
Protective Equipment & Clothing
Use all protective equipment supplied by the operator. Wear closed secure footwear and practical clothing. Loose scarves, jewellery, phones and unsecured belongings must not interfere with driving or moving parts.
River Stop, Weather & Route
At the river stop, children must remain with an adult and avoid slippery rocks or moving water. The operator may change, shorten, delay or cancel the route because of weather, terrain, vehicle condition or participant safety.
The operator’s briefing, vehicle-specific rules, child-passenger approval and instructor decisions always take priority over the advertised route, timing, river stop and general participation information.

Guests must remain seated while the vehicle is moving, keep arms and personal items inside, avoid standing or changing seats, and follow the driver during all sections of the mountain route.
Children & Supervision

Waterfalls, Viewpoints & Stops

The driver may change, shorten, delay or cancel parts of the route because of rain, heat, road conditions, traffic, vehicle safety, local restrictions or the needs of children in the group.

About this experience
Gazipasa Bays is an exclusive journey through the hidden paradises of Gazipasa, combining ancient history, natural wonders and time to relax in exceptionally beautiful bays far from mass tourism.
This tour is designed for travelers who appreciate atmospheric locations, turquoise water, ancient ruins and the authentic natural beauty of Turkey.
Delik Deniz — King’s Bay
is one of the most beautiful and unusual places on the coast, with crystal-clear turquoise water and a giant natural rock arch opening directly toward the sea.
Antiochia ad Cragum
is an ancient city located high above the sea amid dramatic landscapes. Its ruins, columns and remains of old streets create the feeling of traveling back in time.
Aytap / Iotape
is a unique coastal archaeological site where the history of the ancient world meets the blue Mediterranean Sea.
Yalan Dünya Cave
is an impressive natural cave with stalactites and stalagmites, hidden among the rocks and landscapes of the region.
This journey is a wonderful alternative to classic sightseeing tours and reveals a completely different side of the Alanya coastline.

About this experience
Green Canyon is a peaceful and scenic journey to one of the most beautiful natural locations in the Mediterranean region. The majestic Taurus Mountains, emerald water and a deeply relaxing atmosphere create the perfect day away from the city.
The experience takes place as a comfortable sightseeing cruise across one of Türkiye’s most beautiful reservoirs. The route is surrounded by dense forests, rocky shores and panoramic natural landscapes.
After pickup from your hotel, you travel toward Green Canyon. The journey takes approximately two hours each way. A professional tour guide accompanies the group and shares information about the history, nature and character of the region.
On arrival, you board a comfortable sightseeing boat and begin a cruise across the turquoise reservoir among mountain landscapes. The program includes swimming stops, time to relax outdoors, fishing from the boat and panoramic island views.
Lunch is served at a restaurant by the canyon with a beautiful panoramic view. Main-course choices include chicken, fish or meatballs, accompanied by a side dish and unlimited soft drinks according to the program.
This tour is ideal for families with children, couples and guests who enjoy nature, peaceful surroundings, beautiful photography and a relaxed day outdoors.

Frequently Asked Questions
Is Green Canyon suitable for children?
Yes. The cruise is calm and family-friendly. Parents should supervise children closely during swimming stops and while moving around the boat.
Is swimming compulsory?
No. Swimming is optional. Guests may remain on the boat and enjoy the scenery during the stops.
Are fishing rods included?
Fishing equipment is provided on board according to availability and the tour program.
What food and drinks are included?
Lunch includes a choice of chicken, fish or meatballs with a side dish. Soft drinks are included according to the program.
How long is the transfer?
The drive takes approximately two hours each way, depending on your pickup area and traffic conditions.
What should I bring?
Bring swimwear, a towel, sunscreen, sunglasses, comfortable shoes, weather-appropriate clothing and a phone for contact.
Is the local zoo entrance included?
No. Zoo entrance costs €5 per person. Photos with selected animals are available for an additional fee and depend on availability and zoo rules.

Participation is subject to the horse club’s final safety assessment. Horse selection, route access, riding format and permission to continue are determined according to the rider’s age, height, weight, balance and experience, as well as horse welfare, equipment fit and current conditions.

Guests must attend the full briefing and follow the instructor during mounting, the trial ride, the route, stops and dismounting. Riding away from the group or ignoring commands is not permitted.

About this experience
Istanbul by Plane
is a full-day cultural journey from Alanya to Türkiye’s largest city and former imperial capital. The tour is designed for guests who want to experience the Historic Peninsula, major monuments and the Bosphorus without a long road journey.
The program combines round-trip domestic flights, airport and hotel transfers, guide service, meals, entrance tickets and a shared Bosphorus sightseeing cruise. Istanbul’s historic areas preserve landmarks from the Roman, Byzantine and Ottoman periods, creating one of the world’s most distinctive cityscapes.
Visits may include Hagia Sophia, the Blue Mosque, Topkapi Palace and other confirmed attractions in the Historic Peninsula. Access and the order of visits may change because of flight schedules, traffic, prayer times, attraction opening conditions and the local partner’s daily program.
The Bosphorus cruise offers views of waterfront palaces, historic mansions, fortresses, bridges and the meeting point of Europe and Asia.

About The Land of Legends
The Land of Legends in Belek is much more than a traditional amusement park. It brings together themed entertainment lands, water attractions, family zones, roller coasters, character experiences, live shows, restaurants and Shopping Avenue in one large resort-style destination.
Families with children can explore colourful areas inspired by Nickelodeon characters, PAW Patrol, SpongeBob, Masha and the Bear and other themed worlds. At the same time, teenagers and adults can choose faster rides, major roller coasters, high-energy slides and adrenaline attractions.
Water entertainment is spread across areas such as Aqua Land, Tropic Lagoon and other seasonal water zones, with pools, slides, family experiences and more intense attractions. Not every attraction is suitable for every guest: height, age, weight and safety restrictions apply individually.
In the evening, Shopping Avenue becomes a separate entertainment setting with illuminated canals, restaurants, shops, fountain effects and seasonal live events. The current program may include the Musical Boat Parade, character appearances, music, light effects and stage performances.

About this experience
This full-day route combines Roman architecture, ancient coastal heritage and one of the best-known nature stops in the Manavgat region.
Aspendos is famous for its exceptionally preserved 2nd-century Roman theatre. The wider archaeological site also includes remains of the acropolis, basilica, agora, baths and ancient aqueduct system.
In Side, guests explore accessible parts of the ancient peninsula, including historic streets, the harbour area and the Temple of Apollo beside the Mediterranean. Side Theatre access depends on the current restoration status.
Manavgat Waterfall provides a relaxing nature and photo stop before the return journey.
Lunch, hotel transfer, guide service, travel insurance, the Aspendos entrance ticket and the Manavgat Waterfall entrance ticket are included.

Discover two extraordinary landscapes in one unforgettable journey from Alanya: the turquoise protected scenery of Salda Lake and the UNESCO-listed natural and ancient heritage of Pamukkale and Hierapolis.

About this experience
Discover two of Türkiye’s most extraordinary landscapes in one remarkable journey from Alanya.
The first major stop is
Salda Lake
, a protected high-alkaline lake surrounded by pine-covered landscapes and famous for its exceptionally clear turquoise water and bright white mineral shoreline. Often called the
“Turkish Maldives,”
Salda is far more than a beautiful photo location: its magnesium-rich geological formations have attracted scientific interest because of their similarities to mineral structures studied in Mars’s Jezero Crater.
The lake lies within a Special Environmental Protection Area created to preserve its rare geological formations, water quality and biodiversity. During the stop, guests can enjoy the scenery, walk in permitted areas and take photographs. Access to the shoreline and swimming may vary depending on current environmental protection rules and the section visited.
The journey continues to
Pamukkale
, where calcite-rich thermal waters have created dazzling white terraces, petrified cascades and natural basins above the surrounding plain.
Above the travertines stands
Hierapolis
, an ancient Greco-Roman thermal city founded by the kings of Pergamon in the late second century BC. The site includes a monumental Roman theatre, ancient baths, temples, streets, a vast necropolis and important early Christian monuments.
Pamukkale and Hierapolis together form a UNESCO World Heritage Site, combining an exceptional natural landscape with one of Anatolia’s most important ancient thermal settlements.
When booked with our agency, entrance tickets to Pamukkale, Hierapolis and the Archaeology Museum are already included in the stated tour price.
The journey also includes hotel transfer, guide service, insurance and meals according to the confirmed program. Because this is a long-distance full-day tour with a very early departure, guests should be prepared for extended travel time.

items.faq:
Do I need previous experience?
No. The flight is tandem and controlled by a professional pilot. You only need to follow the take-off and landing instructions.
How long is the flight?
Flight duration depends on wind, weather, passenger weight and the selected launch point. The exact duration cannot be guaranteed in advance.
Can the flight be postponed?
Yes. Flights may be delayed, rescheduled or cancelled when wind or weather conditions are unsuitable for safe operation.
Are photos and videos included?
No. The professional in-flight photo and video package is optional and paid separately.
What shoes should I wear?
Wear secure lace-up sports shoes. Sandals, slippers and loose footwear are not suitable for take-off and landing.
Can children participate?
Participation depends on age, weight, height, equipment fit, weather and final pilot approval. Child pricing is the same unless otherwise confirmed.
Is hotel transfer included?

Where do we land?
Landing is normally near Cleopatra Beach, but the pilot may change the landing point according to wind and safety conditions.

Do I need previous experience?

How long is the flight?

Can the flight be postponed?

Are photos and videos included?

What shoes should I wear?

Parasailing Adventure in Alanya
Fly above the turquoise Mediterranean coast
Lift off from a speedboat and enjoy a smooth flight above Alanya with panoramic views of Cleopatra Beach, Alanya Castle, pirate ships, the harbor and the Taurus Mountains.

About This Experience
Parasailing Adventure is one of the most spectacular ways to see Alanya from above.
You take off smoothly from the rear platform of a specially equipped speedboat and rise above the turquoise Mediterranean. As the coastline opens beneath you, the noise fades and the experience becomes calm, weightless and panoramic.
From the air you may see Cleopatra Beach, Alanya Castle, the harbour, passing boats and the Taurus Mountains. No previous experience is required: the crew prepares the equipment, explains the position for takeoff and landing, and controls the flight from the boat.
Solo and tandem flights are available. A triple flight may be possible only after the captain confirms the combined weight, wind and sea conditions.

No experience is needed. The crew manages the boat, equipment and flight line.

Important Private Fishing Safety Rules
Participation is subject to the captain’s final safety decision. The route, fishing locations, swimming permission and continuation of the tour depend on weather, sea conditions, vessel operation and the behaviour of all guests on board.
Captain & Crew Instructions
Guests must follow all captain and crew instructions during boarding, movement around the boat, fishing, meal service, swimming stops and return to the harbour.
Lifejackets & Children
Required life-saving equipment must remain available on board. Children stay under continuous adult supervision, and suitable child-size lifejackets must be confirmed before departure.
Hooks, Lines & Deck Safety
Fishing hooks, knives, lines and tackle must be handled only as instructed. Keep a safe distance while casting, wear non-slip footwear and do not run or leave loose equipment on deck.
Weather, Route & Swimming
The captain may change fishing areas, shorten, delay or cancel the tour because of wind, waves, visibility, technical issues or port restrictions. Swimming is allowed only with explicit crew permission.
The captain’s safety decision, vessel-specific briefing and onboard rules always take priority over the advertised route, time slot, fishing plan and swimming arrangements.

About this experience
Rafting in Köprülü Canyon is one of Turkey’s most popular outdoor adventures, combining mountain scenery, fresh air and an exciting river route.
The experience takes place on the Köprüçay River inside Köprülü Canyon National Park. The rafting route covers approximately 14 kilometres through pine forests, rocky canyon walls and clear mountain water.
Along the way, you will pass sections of lively rapids, enjoy swimming breaks and see the region’s famous ancient Roman bridges.
Before entering the river, professional instructors provide a full safety briefing. All essential rafting equipment is supplied, and experienced guides accompany the group throughout the route.

About this experience
Sapadere Canyon is a refreshing journey into the Taurus Mountains, approximately 40–45 kilometres from central Alanya. The route combines mountain landscapes, waterfalls, clear river water and the peaceful atmosphere of a natural canyon.
The main experience is a walk along the wooden pathway built through the canyon. The route passes between dramatic rock walls, green vegetation, small waterfalls and clear mountain pools, creating excellent opportunities for photographs and a relaxing nature break.
The tour also introduces guests to the traditional character of the Sapadere region through a village stop and local cultural points along the route. Depending on the day’s program, these may include a silk workshop, peanut plantation or historic village mosque.
An optional visit to Dwarf Cave, also known as Cüceler Cave, is available for guests who would like to see natural stalactite formations and atmospheric rock chambers. The cave entrance costs €3 per person and is paid separately.
After exploring the canyon, guests enjoy lunch in a natural setting. Free time is provided for relaxing, taking photographs and swimming where permitted and conditions allow.
This tour is suitable for families, couples and travellers who want to discover a quieter, greener side of the Alanya region away from the busy coastline.

items.faq:
Does the program include three dives?
+
The standard program is planned as three progressive dives at approximately 3–6 m, 7–9 m and 10–12 m. The instructor may reduce the number or depth of dives, or change the route, based on certification, health, readiness and sea conditions.
Can beginners participate?
+
Beginners may participate in an introductory format after the required briefing, health screening and shallow-water practice, under direct professional supervision.
How deep will the dives be?
+
The planned depth scheme is approximately 3–6 m for the first dive, 7–9 m for the second and 10–12 m for the third. These depths are not automatic: the instructor determines the actual depth for each participant.
Can everyone dive?
+
No. Participants complete a health questionnaire, and some answers require medical clearance. Pregnancy, intoxication and certain medical conditions prevent participation.
Can I fly after diving?
+
Diving affects safe flying and altitude timing. Your onward flight or mountain travel must be discussed with the dive centre before participation.
Are transfer and lunch included?
+
Transfer, lunch and the non-diver yacht option are included only when stated in the confirmed package for your date and hotel area.

items.faq:
What are the age and weight limits?
+
The published operator limit is a minimum age of 16 with parental consent and a maximum weight of 100 kg. Final approval remains with the operator after the health and equipment check.
What happens in bad weather?
+
Skydiving operates only in safe aviation conditions. Strong wind, rain, low visibility or operational restrictions may cause a delay, rescheduling or cancellation.
How long does the experience take?
+
The complete operation is usually about 2–3 hours, including preparation and transfer. The aircraft ascent is about 15–20 minutes, freefall about 40–45 seconds and canopy flight about 5–7 minutes.
Can I use my own GoPro or phone?
+
No. Personal cameras are not permitted during the jump. Only licensed professional camera flyers may carry recording equipment.
What should I wear?
+
Wear comfortable sports clothing and closed sports shoes. Sandals and flip-flops are not suitable. Goggles and required jump equipment are provided.
Is the €500 price fixed?
+
€500 is the agreed selling price for this page. Availability, transfer coverage and optional photo or video services are confirmed before booking.

Experience one of the most unforgettable adventures of your life with a tandem skydive above the breathtaking Mediterranean coastline of Manavgat and Side.
Your journey begins with a scenic flight to an altitude of approximately 10,000 feet (about 3,000–3,600 meters), offering spectacular views of the Mediterranean Sea, the Taurus Mountains, river delta landscapes and the golden beaches of the Turkish Riviera.
Then comes the moment you will never forget — an exhilarating freefall at speeds of up to 200 km/h. After the parachute opens, you will enjoy a peaceful canopy flight with incredible panoramic views before a smooth and controlled landing.
Dare to fly. Dare to experience true freedom.

One of those experiences people remember for years, not days.
Signature Views

Frequently Asked Questions
What are the age and weight limits?
+
The published operator limit is a minimum age of 16 with parental consent and a maximum weight of 100 kg. Final approval remains with the operator after the health and equipment check.
What happens in bad weather?
+
Skydiving operates only in safe aviation conditions. Strong wind, rain, low visibility or operational restrictions may cause a delay, rescheduling or cancellation.
How long does the experience take?
+
The complete operation is usually about 2–3 hours, including preparation and transfer. The aircraft ascent is about 15–20 minutes, freefall about 40–45 seconds and canopy flight about 5–7 minutes.
Can I use my own GoPro or phone?
+
No. Personal cameras are not permitted during the jump. Only licensed professional camera flyers may carry recording equipment.
What should I wear?
+
Wear comfortable sports clothing and closed sports shoes. Sandals and flip-flops are not suitable. Goggles and required jump equipment are provided.
Is the €500 price fixed?
+
€500 is the agreed selling price for this page. Availability, transfer coverage and optional photo or video services are confirmed before booking.

Participation is subject to the operator’s final safety approval. The instructor’s briefing, weather conditions, aviation requirements and equipment checks always take priority.
Instructor Instructions
Guests must attend the full safety briefing and follow all instructor and ground-team instructions during preparation, aircraft boarding, freefall, canopy flight and landing.
Age, Weight & Health
Minimum age is 16 with the required consent for minors. Maximum published weight is 100 kg. Health information, body proportions and safe harness fit are checked before approval.
Clothing & Personal Items
Wear closed sports shoes and comfortable clothing. Phones, GoPro cameras, loose jewellery, scarves and unsecured personal items are not permitted during the jump.
Weather & Operations
The operator may delay, change, reschedule or cancel the jump when wind, rain, visibility, air traffic or other operational conditions do not allow safe operation.
Safety has priority over the advertised schedule. The operator’s dropzone rules, instructor briefing, equipment requirements and aviation decisions always take priority.

Syedra Ancient City Tour from Alanya | Alanya Tour Organizations
Home › History & Culture ›
Syedra Ancient City
History & Culture
Syedra Ancient City
Colonnaded Street • Roman Baths • Ancient Cisterns • Mediterranean Panorama
Explore one of Alanya’s most atmospheric archaeological sites, set around 400 metres above the Mediterranean and known for its monumental gate, 250-metre colonnaded street, Roman-period structures and panoramic coastal views.
APPROX. 9 HOURS
ENTRANCE INCLUDED
HOTEL TRANSFER

About this experience
Syedra Ancient City lies approximately 20 kilometres southeast of Alanya on a hillside overlooking the Mediterranean. The settlement traces its origins to the 7th century BC and reached its most prosperous period between the 2nd and 4th centuries AD.
The Upper City stands at an elevation of around 400 metres. Visitors enter through a monumental gate and continue to the approximately 250-metre colonnaded street, once one of the city’s main social spaces.
The archaeological site preserves Roman baths with evidence of mosaic floors, a gymnasium, workshops, numerous plastered cisterns and rock-cut religious spaces. The Cistern Cave and nearby Baptism Cave are among the most distinctive surviving features.
This tour combines archaeology, mountain scenery and wide Mediterranean views. The terrain is uneven and includes slopes, stone paths and steps, so comfortable non-slip footwear is essential.
The order and duration of stops may change according to site conditions, weather, group pace and the confirmed operating program.

Wakeboarding combines speed, balance and technique in one active Mediterranean session.
You ride on a wakeboard while being pulled by a speedboat. Before entering the water, the team explains the start position, handle control, body alignment, safe falling and the signals used by the boat crew.
